questions.cardText:
[History] What was the main goal of the Crusaders during the Crusades?
A. To conquer Asia
B. To spread Catholicism
C. To capture the Holy Land
Answer: C. To capture the Holy Land, particularly Jerusalem, from Muslim control was the main goal of the Crusaders during the various Crusades from the 11th to the 13th centuries.
questions.de: Welche Stadt unter muslimischer Herrschaft sollten die Christen nach dem Aufruf zum Ersten Kreuzzug 1095 zurückerobern – das Hauptziel der Kreuzzüge im Heiligen Land?
questions.en: Which city, under Muslim rule, did the First Crusade's call of 1095 urge Christians to reconquer, as the chief goal of the Crusades in the Holy Land?

timeline.labelEn: The Crusades: papal campaigns to recover and defend the Holy Land, from Urban II's call to the fall of Acre
timeline.labelDe: Die Kreuzzüge: päpstliche Feldzüge zur Rückgewinnung und Verteidigung des Heiligen Landes, vom Aufruf Urbans II. bis zum Fall Akkons

questions.cardText:
[Food Science] What is emulsification?
A. The process of combining fats and oils
B. The process of stably mixing immiscible liquids
C. The process of solidifying liquids
Answer: B. Emulsification is the process of mixing two immiscible liquids, such as oil and water. This is what makes mayonnaise possible. The lecithin in egg yolks is a natural emulsifier that helps blend oil and water into a smooth, stable mixture.
questions.de: Wie heißt der Vorgang, zwei nicht mischbare Flüssigkeiten wie Öl und Wasser stabil zu vermischen, den Eigelb-Lecithin in der Mayonnaise ermöglicht?
questions.en: What is the name of the process of stably mixing two immiscible liquids such as oil and water, which egg-yolk lecithin makes possible in mayonnaise?

timeline.labelEn: André Viard's Le Cuisinier Impérial prints mayonnaise, an egg-yolk-stabilized oil-in-water emulsion, for the first known time
timeline.labelDe: André Viards „Le Cuisinier Impérial“ nennt erstmals bekanntermaßen die Mayonnaise, eine mit Eigelb stabilisierte Öl-in-Wasser-Emulsion

questions.notes: Wikipedia (Emulsion): mayonnaise is an oil-in-water emulsion stabilized with egg-yolk lecithin; emulsification = dispersing immiscible liquids with an emulsifier. Timeline year from the Mayonnaise article.
